text:
Asha: Quick sync — launching the "Starter Spark" cohort tomorrow. Goal: test activation lift from 50 free credits + prompt templates in onboarding. Primary metrics: 7-day activation rate, first-10-requests conversion, and cost per activated user.
Ben: Love it. Quick Q — are we routing inbound signups differently for the cohorts or using feature flags?
Asha: Routing via the routing-service by UTM -> assigns cohort tag on signup. We'll also set a feature flag to enable the promptpack UI. Canary 5% in region-us, then 25%.
Diego: Need the exact UTM params so support and analytics can filter. Also we should reserve a small webinar slot for the cohort demo (30 mins) as an activation nudge.
Asha: UTM scheme (example): `?utm_source=launch-email&utm_campaign=starter_spark_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_cohort=prompt_A` — putting final links in the doc. Also plan: Variant A = credits only; Variant B = credits + onboarding promptpack; Variant C = credits + 3-step email nudge + webinar invite.
Maya: For the webinar invite — we'll route attendees into a special onboarding flow with a tailored prompt template. Who owns the creative for the emails and webinar landing?
Ben: I can take the email copy + CTA. Need the landing mock from design by EOD today. Will reuse the microcopy from the prompt templates doc.
Diego: Analytics asks we tag events: `signup.cohort`, `onboard.prompt_shown`, `first_request`, `webinar.rsvp`. Also flag `dedup_credit_grant` in billing to avoid double granting credits.
Asha: Good call. Product-bot — can you create feature-flag `starter_spark` with variants control/A/B/C and set rollout 5%->25% in us-west/us-east?
product-bot: Created feature-flag `starter_spark` (env: prod). Variants: control(A), promptpack(B), email-nudge(C). 5% rollout scheduled at 2026-03-20T15:00Z, automated step to 25% after 6h.
Maya: Copy ask for Ben: 2 subject lines, 1 short preview, and 3 CTA variants. I'll prep the webinar blurb and the landing header.
Ben: Got it — will drop drafts into the campaign doc and ping design.
Asha: Ops checklist: (1) route signups by UTM, (2) assign cohort tag at signup, (3) grant credits via billing job with `dedup_credit_grant`, (4) feature flag rollout, (5) dashboard in Console: per-cohort 7-day activation and cost. Diego can you own the dashboard query?
Diego: Yep — will add cohort filters + cohort attribution window. Will also add an alert if cost-per-activated crosses $25.
Maya: One more — we should surface one sample prompt template in the invite so users see immediate value. Suggest using the 'quickstarter' prompt.
Asha: Agreed. Final: deploy links with UTM in #campaigns doc, notify #support with steps, and schedule a 9:30 sync tomorrow for final go/no-go. :rocket: 
Ben: :thumbsup:
Diego: :raised_hands:
product-bot: Reminder: rollout scheduled — will post status updates in this thread at each step.
